content.short: Demex is a decentralized exchange for spot, perpetual, futures, lending, borrowing, staking, and liquidity pools.
content.description: Demex, also called Decentralized Mercantile Exchange, is a decentralized trading platform built for a fully on-chain financial system. Its documentation describes support for order-book trading, spot markets, perpetuals, futures, lending and borrowing, staking, and liquidity pools. Demex uses a fast finality trading environment and an oracle network designed to update asset data quickly for on-chain markets. For Mantle users, Demex adds a multi-product DeFi venue where trading, earning, and market creation can happen from one platform instead of separate applications.
